core_law: Preserve intentional Musical INTRO when it adds value
Offer Clean Start / With Music INTRO only when both reviewed clone variants exist

buyer_language.optional_reviewed_variant: Start with a short musical lead-in

buyer_checkbox_rule: Do not show a buyer checkbox unless both variants actually exist, play correctly, preserve endings, and have passed admin/KKr review.
parent_source_law: PIX, LT-PIX, KK, BLK, sub-BLK, and Song Section checkpoint remain source truth. No parent source is destructively edited to fix a child KUT.
clone_level_law: All intro removal, padding, fading, DP, tail repair, Twinkle/STI transition, and variant creation happen only on the derived KUT candidate clone/version, with provenance preserved.
final_operational_law: Default = no Musical INTRO. Words first. Music supports. Clean starts must still breathe. Protected endings must still resolve. Twinkle/STI follows only after the vocal/content tail is safely preserved.
